item.title: Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant Operating on Backup Power for 3 Consecutive Days
item.summary: SIMFEROPOL (Sputnik) - The Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) has been operating on backup power from diesel generators for three days in a row due to a lack of external power supply, ZNPP communications director Yevgenia Yashina told Sputnik on Saturday.
